title: Make release evidence portable
summary: Expanded the headless DevLog engine with validated release data, deployment lifecycle primitives, batched commit evidence, and reusable collection behavior.
notes: Added runtime checks that reject malformed, duplicated, or mismatched public release records before the site builds.
Added reusable lifecycle, included-commit, source fallback, release selection, highlighting, date, and pagination models without changing the pixel interface.
Proved the expanded package in Audio Browser Lab while keeping storage, routing, copy, and visual design under project control.

title: Make every release attributable
summary: Added portable author and source metadata through the first integration of a reusable headless DevLog package.
notes: Added the release author, GitHub profile image, and linked short commit to every public entry.
Built a project-neutral DevLog package with public and private capability policies.
Kept Audio Browser Lab's pixel interface separate from the shared release logic.

title: Unify the working surface
summary: Consolidated the homepage into one responsive audio workspace and tightened the release page opening.
notes: Combined file input, live mission status, browser clocks, and diagnostic findings into one workspace.
Removed duplicate controls and duplicate page anchors from the homepage.
Verified the public copyright line for Flygon LC.
Removed redundant introductory copy from the DevLog hero.
Kept the public release record aligned with the shared Phoenix calendar cadence.

title: Polish loading and site discovery
summary: Made movement between the lab and DevLog feel intentional while helping people and search engines find every public page.
notes: Added responsive loading skeletons and reduced-motion-aware page transitions.
Rebuilt the footer around clearer project, privacy, source, DevLog, and sitemap paths.
Generated a public sitemap during every development and production build.

title: Make the public trail unmistakable
summary: Refined the footer so the DevLog and local-first privacy promises stay visible together.
notes: Moved the public DevLog link into the release and privacy status cluster.
Replaced shorthand privacy claims with clearer language about local files and usage tracking.

title: A clearer lab on every screen
summary: Rebuilt the public experience around a faster path from audio file to useful evidence.
notes: Introduced a responsive navigation, tighter information hierarchy, and more legible diagnostic panels.
Added this public DevLog and connected every page through a shared footer.
Aligned package metadata and public copyright with the MIT-licensed Flygon LC project.

title: The full toolkit leaves the bench
summary: Turned the browser experiment into an installable, multi-surface audio diagnostics toolkit.
notes: Published the web lab with local-only file analysis and portable JSON reports.
Added browser, Howler, WaveSurfer, CLI, HTTP API, and MCP integration surfaces.
Documented the cross-browser Howler seek problem and the evidence needed to isolate it.
